titleStmt.title: The Secretary of State to the Acting Secretary of State

head.hi: The Secretary of State to the Acting Secretary of State

note.p: According to telegram 852, September 18, from New York, Mr. Fawzi informally informed the United States Delegation on September 18 that the proposed U.S. resolution was not acceptable to Prime Minister Nokrashy because the proposal amounted to a dismissal of the Egyptian case (501.BC/9–1847).

Telegram 856, September 19, from New York, reported that Sir Alexander Cadogan, the following day, informed the United States Delegation that he too did not like the U.S. resolution, stating that “if the reference to the Egyptian desire for evacuation of British troops were retained in the proposed resolution, language should be included noting that the British have the right under treaty to station such troops there.” (501.BC/9–1947)
